topPRs.title: chore: remove sunset chains (Automata, Lisk, Mint, Polynomial, Redstone, Superseed, Xterio)
topPRs.author: sbvegan
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Removes 8 chains (7 mainnet, 1 Sepolia) that have shut down. Each one meets both criteria:
1. **Operator-confirmed shutdown**: a first-party announcement, or a retirement notice served by the chain's own RPC.
2. **Stopped on L1**: no batches to the chain's batch inbox for weeks or longer, as of 2026-11-17.

| Chain | Network | Chain ID | Last L1 batch | Shutdown evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Automata | mainnet | 65536 | 2026-07-14 | Public RPC returns *"Automata Attestation L2 is retired; remaining L2 balances were refunded"*; [docs](https://docs.ata.network/attestation-l2) |
| Lisk | mainnet | 1135 | 2026-11-09 | [Lisk Chain closure FAQ](https://support.lisk.com/faq/lisk-chain-closure): chain wound down 2026-10-31 |
| Lisk Sepolia | sepolia | 4202 | 2026-09-01 | Sunset with the Lisk Chain; RPC offline |
| Mint | mainnet | 185 | 2026-04-07 | Shutdown announced 2026-04-17; withdrawal deadline was 2026-10-20 ([L2BEAT](https://l2beat.com/scaling/projects/mint)) |
| Polynomial | mainnet | 8008 | 2026-04-21 | [Shutdown announcement coverage](https://www.crowdfundinsider.com/2026/02/262470-polynomial-to-cease-operations-were-shutting-down-instead-of-launching-a-token-for-a-dying-product/); chain shutdown planned for 2026-03-03 |
| Redstone | mainnet | 690 | 2026-05-21 | [Lattice announcement](https://x.com/latticexyz/status/2044103611072835744); chain stopped 2026-05-15 |
| Superseed | mainnet | 5330 | 2026-10-22 | [Superseed's Next Chapter](https://superseed.xyz/blog/superseeds-next-chapter): bridge-off deadline 2026-08-15 |
| Xterio Chain (ETH) | mainnet | 2702128 | 2025-04-17 | [Migration to BNB Chain](https://info.xter.io/xterio-chain-migration); deposits disabled 2025-04-18 |

## Changes

- Removed each chain with `just remove-chain <chain-id>`, which deletes `superchain/configs/<network>/<chain>.toml` and `superchain/extra/genesis/<network>/<chain>.json.zst`
- Regenerated `chainList.json`, `chainList.toml`, `CHAINS.md` and `superchain/extra/addresses/addresses.json` with `just codegen <rpcs> mainnet,sepolia`, the same scope `check-codegen` uses in CI

**Codegen also updated one unrelated value:** the OP Mainnet (chain 10) `Proposer` in `addresses.json` changes from `0x473300df…3A33` to `0xc27ba3E0…5bE0`. The new address matches the proposer in `DisputeGameFactory.gameArgs(5)` on L1, the only game type OP Mainnet has registered. `check-codegen` requires this change.

## Testing

- `just codegen` succeeded for mainnet and sepolia
- `just check-genesis-integrity` and `just check-chainlist` pass
- `validation` Go tests pass
- `ops/internal/{deployer,report,validation}` tests fail locally, and they fail the same way on unmodified `main`. They need deployer binaries and RPC env vars that my machine doesn't have, so CI is the real check for them.

## Not included (follow-up candidates)

These chains have also stopped posting to L1, and their public RPCs are dead. I found **no first-party shutdown announcement** for any of them, so they are left for a separate decision:

- **Mainnet:** Ethernity/Epic Chain (183), RACE (6805), Binary (624), Silent Data (380929)
- **Sepolia:** Camp V2 (325000), Cyber (111557560), Funki (3397901), Ozean (7849306), Pivotal (16481), RACE (6806), Radius (863), Binary (625)
